tests.name: Open a signoff pull request on a sandbox repo, push a revision to the same pull request, merge it, then start the next stage

reported.evidence: Run on subhagho/FieldML on 2026-10-23 with the real GitHub adapter: pull request #6 (issue #5) was opened by openSignoff, readSignoffRequest answered its branch and open, changes were recorded, the DEF was re-authored through writeArtifact (Signoff entry kept), a second commit was pushed to the same branch, openSignoff went back to the same request #6 (one pull request on the branch with 2 commits, no second one), the next stage was refused while it was open, the merge was recorded signed-off on DEF and HLD by settleForAttempt, the claim was released and the next stage was allowed. The pull request shows MERGED.

titles.title: changes requested on a two-artifact request, both re-authored through writeArtifact or one left unchanged, approved again and resubmitted to the same request, settled signed-off for the new revisions only, a lingering old decision not cancelling it, a merged request not carried over, and a non-holder and an unassigned user refused
